body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2008') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics displayed its 10-inch mini notebook pc 'Xnote MINI(model:X110)' during KES 2008, which features its all-in-one body color available in pink, white and black. Powered by Intel Atom processor and Windows XP operating system, the Xnote MINI adopts 160GB HDD, 1GB DDR2 memory and a 10-inch LCD display with WSVGA(1024*600) resolution and LED back light. Weighing 1.19kg, the Xnote MINI supports a 1.3M webcam, 4-in-1 memory slot, 54Mbps wireless LAN and Bluetooth 2.0 connectivity.
